description: Grid mode (C1, item 4): 4 panels with different colourings; linked cameras verified with a real mouse drag; hover in panel 3 matches nearest projected point; lasso across panels; PNG export. Panels start below the top-band (76 px) so the toolbar does not overlap any panel's data.
setup:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
n = 2000
k = rng.integers(0, 3, n)
centers = rng.normal(0, 8, (3, 20))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 20)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(20)])
df['cluster'] = [f'grp_{v}' for v in k]
df['score'] = df['x0'] * 2 + rng.normal(0, 1, n)
